messages:
kai: Observed a consistent p95 jump on short prompt workloads after the 'early-bind + sync-fingerprint' roll. GPU unaffected, host parse/tokenization is the blocker.

olga: Can you paste the perf numbers?

kai: From trace sampler (short-chat):
```
host_total_ms p50: 1.7  p95: 72 (+28)  p99: 110
parse/tokenize_ms p95: 16.9 (+14)
fingerprint_ms p95: 8.2 (sync)
stream_writev_calls p95: 3 (was 1)
kvcache_lock_ms p95: 2.6 (increased)
```

samir: Which CL introduced early-bind? I think it made fingerprint selection synchronous so we can eager-attach to kernel batches.

kai: CL: b4c7e9 - enabled early_bind and sync_fingerprint in ingress. Also added a canonicalize-meta step that reserializes headers.

trent: That canonicalize-meta likely allocates + memcpy for every request. For tiny chats that overhead plus sync fingerprint could push us into ICU-backed token path. Any flamegraph?

kai: Flamegraph excerpt: ingress.recv -> canonicalize_meta -> sync_fingerprint -> proto_unwrap -> utf8_normalize -> token_adapter_fallback -> memmove / ICU loads. Separate stack: streaming.writer -> chunk_align -> multiple writev syscall nodes.

olga: Repro with perf-client: send 4-token prompts w/ metadata V=small. Strace diff: slow path shows open("/usr/lib/icu/..."), mmap, and 2-4 writev calls instead of single writev.

samir: So three levers: (1) sync fingerprint forcing legacy adapter, (2) meta canonicalization allocs, (3) chunk alignment creating small frames.

trent: Quick mitigations we can try: disable sync_fingerprint (make it async), change canonicalize to in-place ascii-only lowercase fastpath + pooled proto buffer, and make chunker prefer coalescing writes unless payload > 768 bytes.

olga: Also add cheap ascii-bailout in tokenization: scan bytes and if all < 0x80 skip ICU normalize. That is a tiny win and easy to A/B.

kai: I'll roll back b4c7e9 on canary now to confirm.

deploy-bot: rollback: reverted CL b4c7e9 on eng-runtime/canary at 14:32 UTC.

kai: After rollback p95 dropped to near baseline within 7 minutes. KV stats steady. Confirms host-side parse + framing costs.

samir: For the reintroduce plan:
- make fingerprint async: produce a tentative decision and defer heavy work to worker; default to safe token_adapter_v3 if uncertain
- implement ascii-fastpath before any unicode normalization in ingress
- change canonicalize-meta to in-place ascii-lowercase for common keys and use a per-thread buffer pool for reserialization
- update chunker to attempt writev coalesce and only split when flush requested or payload > 768B
- add e2e perf test covering grpc streaming with short prompts and common tenant metadata shapes

trent: Add a unit test that asserts we never call ICU in the hot path for ascii-only short prompts. Also add a perf regression alert if host p95 increases >10ms on short-chat suite.

olga: I'll take the canonicalize + buffer pool work. Samir can handle async fingerprint + safe-default mapping. Kai will do the chunk coalesce change and ascii-fastpath test.

samir: Note: when making fingerprint async, ensure we don't starve kvcache warmers; use best-effort kernel prefetch without blocking request path.

trent: Good call. Also be careful with the safe-default mapping: prefer v3 adapter for ambiguous shapes common in client libs. Add telemetry tags so we can see routing counts.

kai: Opening PRs after I validate microbench. Will run stateless canary with async fingerprint + coalesce knob off-by-default.

deploy-bot: stateless-canary scheduled with rollback config at 15:00 UTC; will run 20m trace collection.

olga: Thx. Keep this thread updated w/ traces. :thumbsup:
